descriptions.w3d_d29b_row_80086b08: Terrain row walk: reads corner heights from the float grid (bounded by +488, stride byte +492) and bounds-checked samples of the images +8 and +4 (the latter doubled) shifted by +504; for 7 cells shifts the windows one column, reads the next column, derives the midpoints +2552..+2568 and draws the cell (0x80086660) with a position copy, advancing the output 18 bytes, flags 9, position x by 1.0 and the tag byte.
